chunks: They will burn in it on the Day of Judgement,

key_terms.يَصْلَوْنَهَا: They will burn in it (referring to Hell)

ai.seo_question: What happens to disbelievers on the Day of Judgement according to Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine justice, where the 'Day of Deen' (Religion/Reckoning) serves as the ultimate manifestation of God's fairness. It highlights that the punishment is not merely physical but a spiritual consequence of rejecting the truth, aligning with the concept of *Haqq* (Truth) in Shia theology.
